d: An evil arthritic rancher and his murderous daughter are having settlers killed to prevent them from selling their land to the railroad.
When a young boy nurses an injured hawk back to health, he gains newfound courage and confidence on his own.
The Wild West adventures of Ben Cartwright and his sons as they run and defend their Nevada ranch while helping the surrounding community.

A young doctor is forced by a female outlaw to a town run entirely by women, where men are only allowed to work in or visit the crooked gambling hall. As the town's independence is threatened by notorious outlaws and a new marshal's election, where women have no say, tensions rise, and the doctor becomes entangled in the town's fate.
